title: Data Scientist / Associate Analytics Specialist
job_description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to transform large-scale multi-source data into actionable business intelligence and predictive models. You will design statistical experiments, clean complex messy datasets, engineer domain features, and deploy machine learning models.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and data wrangling on millions of records using Pandas and NumPy.
- Develop supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Scikit-Learn and XGBoost.
- Formulate SQL queries to extract, transform, and aggregate data from PostgreSQL / Snowflake data warehouses.
- Build informative interactive dashboards using Streamlit, Plotly, or Tableau to communicate statistical findings.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers to integrate predictive inference into production workflows.

Minimum Qualifications:
- B.Tech / M.Tech in CS, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or related STEM field.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data manipulation libraries (Pandas, NumPy).
- Demonstrated understanding of statistical hypothesis testing, regression, classification, and evaluation metrics (ROC-AUC, F1-Score).
- Experience with version control (Git) and reproducible Jupyter notebooks.
min_education: B.Tech / M.Tech in CS / IT / Data Science / Statistics
